scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic automata, integer polynomial identities and rational Sturm separations prove the forbidden-word series and strict entropy inequality. Published Wu–Zhang theorem supplies the stated corollary; finite enumeration is corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the bilateral two-step spatial image of synchronous Rule 126; exact number or structure of maximal-entropy measures is not calculated. The qualitative measure conclusion uses an existing theorem; historical novelty is limited to the inspected sources.
title: Exact obstruction entropy and a strict entropy gap in the second image of Rule 126
